categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two business systems: technology services and intelligent equipment. Technology services include energy storage system technical services and testing, inspection, and commissioning services. Intelligent equipment comprises intelligent monitoring devices, intelligent power distribution equipment, robots, and drones. These services and products support power generation, transmission, distribution, and user-side applications, focusing on clean energy and smart grid development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include energy storage system integration and safety protection, high-precision power electronics modeling and grid connection performance evaluation, energy management and optimization control, intelligent secondary equipment testing, modular hardware design for power distribution automation, and multi-modal AI for intelligent monitoring and robotics. The company emphasizes R&D in AI, digital twins, cloud-edge collaboration, and advanced materials like silicon carbide power modules. Production mainly involves software development, hardware customization, prototyping, and outsourced mass production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily power system enterprises, including Southern Power Grid and State Grid, as well as large power generation companies and industrial users. The company serves the electric power industry chain covering power generation, grid transmission, distribution, and end-user energy management. It also extends services to sectors like transportation and municipal infrastructure through intelligent monitoring and robotics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in China, with a strong presence in Guangdong Province and expanding markets in other southern provinces such as Guangxi, Yunnan, Guizhou, and Hainan. It also has projects and business activities in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam. The company is expanding its marketing and service network across Southern China and key national markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric power supply chain. It provides technical services and intelligent equipment that support power generation, grid transmission and distribution, and user-side energy management. It integrates technology development, system integration, testing, and commissioning services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the power energy system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing new energy storage technologies, smart grid digitalization, AI-enabled intelligent monitoring, and robotics for power system operation and maintenance. The company focuses on innovation in energy storage integration, flexible grid interaction (source-grid-load-storage), and development of proprietary operating systems like 'Silk Road InOS' for intelligent power distribution. It actively participates in national and provincial R&D projects, standards formulation, and aims to lead in new energy and smart grid technology innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of intelligent equipment and provision of technical services, including energy storage system integration, testing, inspection, and commissioning. The company adopts a project-based pricing model, often through competitive bidding and customized solutions. It also earns income from licensing, technology transfer, and investment returns from equity holdings in related enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the Chinese power technology sector, particularly in new energy storage and smart grid equipment. It competes with other domestic power technology firms and benefits from strong backing by state-owned enterprises like Southern Power Grid. Its industry position is reinforced by extensive R&D capabilities, comprehensive service offerings, and strategic partnerships within the power industry ecosystem.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately 3.01 billion RMB, an 18.77% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 365 million RMB, up 29.79%. The company maintains a solid growth trajectory with increasing R&D investment (7.39% of revenue) and expanding market share, especially outside Guangdong Province. Total assets reached about 4.71 billion RMB, reflecting steady scale expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing integrated 'technology services + intelligent equipment' solutions that enhance power system safety, efficiency, and clean energy integration. Its differentiation lies in proprietary core technologies, comprehensive lifecycle services, and strong innovation capabilities in energy storage, AI-enabled monitoring, and robotics. The company’s products and services support flexible, reliable, and intelligent power systems, aligning with national energy transition and carbon neutrality goals.
